key_insight: CatAI reuses modular physicochemical knowledge to guide catalyst discovery across mechanistically distinct reactions.
engineering_relevance: The framework links structure–property data to catalytic objectives, supporting computational screening and iterative model–experiment optimization.
method: Organize knowledge into 30 reusable physicochemical encoders.
Compose task-specific models for screening and closed-loop discovery.
evidence_signal: CatAI reports 7.8% lower task-averaged prediction error than next-best models, a polymer-synthesis catalyst with 9× commercial-benchmark activity, and a Cu-based photocatalyst outperforming traditional Ni-based systems for C–O coupling.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish how reliably performance transfers to reactions or operating conditions beyond those evaluated.
paper_title: Adaptive catalyst discovery emerges from composable scientific intelligence
